Full-Stack Software Engineer 
*How do you take a feature from its first refinement conversation all the way to monitoring it live in production? As a Full-Stack Software Engineer at Budget Thuis you do exactly that: full-stack in C# and TypeScript, across a landscape of independent microservices. Sounds like your kind of work? Apply below.** 
**What you'll do** 
* Design and build features across our microservices landscape, working full-stack in C# and TypeScript, from first refinement through deployment and monitoring in production. 
* You don't just build what's asked, you push back when there's a better way. Question assumptions in refinement and architecture discussions, and speak up when you see a stronger solution. 
* Improve our CI/CD pipelines and engineering practices, not just the code that runs through them. 
* Use AI tools like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot in your daily workflow to work faster and sharper. 
* Work closely with engineers across the domain to keep our systems reliable and maintainable. 
**About the team** 
You join the team behind the Internet and TV services of Budget Thuis, one of the four largest energy providers in the Netherlands. Our dynamic energy product alone serves a huge base of customers, so the systems you work on run at real scale. It's a small, international team of engineers, tech leads and product managers, and our working language is English. We work in OKRs and are actively shaping a new way of working, so you help decide both what we build and how we get there. People here question each other's plans and expect the same back, and CI/CD is something the whole team owns, not a black box someone else maintains.

In increasingly complex projects, time, scope, budget and quality together determine the end result. When changes are insufficiently incorporated or progress is not clear, projects are delayed, costs increase and the overview disappears. 
Professional planning & scheduling ensures that you not only know where you stand, but also what needs to be done to stay on track. It makes deviations visible before they have consequences and provides room for timely adjustments. What is planning & scheduling? 
Planning & scheduling is the process of creating, monitoring and adjusting a realistic project plan. It goes beyond creating a timeline: - Scope, resources and dependencies are identified - Alternatives and scenarios are considered in advance - Impact of changes is made visible 
The goal: grip on execution, predictability for management and a reliable compass for the entire project team. 
 Why is it crucial within projects? 
Without tight planning & scheduling, you run the risk of: - Important milestones are missed - Resources are used incorrectly or inefficiently - Anomalies do not become visible until late - Teams working alongside each other - Budgets come under pressure 
A plan that is understood and supported by the team increases the likelihood of fewer delays and can help reduce costs.
